SELECT
LOG_ID, CNTC_ID, TEST_CLASS_NM, MNGR_NM, MNGR_EMAIL_ADRES, MNTRNG_STTUS, LOG_INFO, CREAT_DT, FRST_REGISTER_ID, TO_CHAR(FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYY-MM-DD'), LAST_UPDUSR_ID, TO_CHAR(LAST_UPDT_PNTTM,'YYYY-MM-DD')
ZIP, SN, CTPRVN_NM, SIGNGU_NM, EMD_NM, LI_BULD_NM, LNBR_DONG_HO, TO_CHAR(FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYY-MM-DD'), FRST_REGISTER_ID, TO_CHAR(LAST_UPDT_PNTTM,'YYYY-MM-DD'), LAST_UPDUSR_ID
*
FROM
htrsmrcvmntrngloginfo
czip
whitelist_table_required
ORDER BY FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC LIMIT #{TRGET_SVC_LIST_CO}::NUMERIC OFFSET 0

SELECT A.RSS_ID, A.TRGET_SVC_NM, A.TRGET_SVC_TABLE, A.HDER_TITLE, A.HDER_LINK, A.HDER_DC HDER_DESCRIPTION, A.HDER_TAG, A.HDER_ETC, A.BDT_TITLE, A.BDT_LINK, A.BDT_DC BDT_DESCRIPTION, A.BDT_TAG, A.BDT_ETC_TAG BDT_ETC, A.FRST_REGISTER_ID, TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYYmmdd') FRST_REGISTER_PNTTM, (SELECT USER_NM FROM COMVNUSERMASTER WHERE ESNTL_ID = A.FRST_REGISTER_ID) FRST_REGISTER_NM FROM NRSS A WHERE 1=1
AND A.TRGET_SVC_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND A.TRGET_SVC_TABLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

SELECT COUNT(*) totcnt FROM NRSS A WHERE 1=1
AND A.TRGET_SVC_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND A.TRGET_SVC_TABLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

SELECT RSS_ID "RSS_ID", TRGET_SVC_NM "TRGET_SVC_NM", TRGET_SVC_TABLE "TRGET_SVC_TABLE", TRGET_SVC_LIST_CO "TRGET_SVC_LIST_CO", HDER_TITLE "HDER_TITLE", HDER_LINK "HDER_LINK", HDER_DC "HDER_DESCRIPTION", HDER_TAG "HDER_TAG", HDER_ETC "HDER_ETC", BDT_TITLE "BDT_TITLE", BDT_LINK "BDT_LINK", BDT_DC "BDT_DESCRIPTION", BDT_TAG "BDT_TAG", BDT_ETC_TAG "BDT_ETC", FRST_REGISTER_ID "FRST_REGISTER_ID", FRST_REGIST_PNTTM "FRST_REGISTER_PNTTM", LAST_UPDUSR_ID "LAST_UPDUSR_ID" FROM NRSS WHERE 1=1 AND RSS_ID=#{rssId}
